# Tiny Swords Free Pack (local runtime dependency)

The local development checkout uses `Particle FX` and `UI Elements/UI Elements/Cursors` from the pack at:

`F:\Desktop\TowerDefense\Tiny Swords (Free Pack)`

Copy the seven mapped particle sheets into `particle_fx/` and the four cursor PNGs into `cursors/`. These source PNGs are ignored by Git because Pixel Frog permits use in personal and commercial projects but prohibits redistributing or repackaging the assets. Obtain the pack from its [official page](https://pixelfrog-assets.itch.io/tiny-swords) before setting up another checkout.

| Runtime role | Source PNG |
|---|---|
| Ballista impact | `Particle FX/Dust_01.png` |
| Mortar impact | `Particle FX/Explosion_01.png` |
| Tesla Coil discharge | `Particle FX/TeslaCoil.png` |
| Frost Keep impact | `Particle FX/Ice_01.png` |
| Flame Thrower impact | `Particle FX/Fire_03.png` |
| Poison Sprayer impact | `Particle FX/Poison.png` |
| Shredder impact | `Particle FX/Blood.png` |
| Default cursor | `UI Elements/UI Elements/Cursors/Cursor_01.png` |
| Interactable hover | `UI Elements/UI Elements/Cursors/Cursor_02.png` |
| Invalid action | `UI Elements/UI Elements/Cursors/Cursor_03.png` |
| Tower placement | `UI Elements/UI Elements/Cursors/Cursor_04.png` |
